technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum with golden cross and volume spike, but overbought conditions and price below intermediate moving averages create pullback risk; suitable for swing entry with tight stops.

fundamental.summary: PEG shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying engagement, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 105 days present elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market sentiment neutral with slight bearish lean (32.9%); insufficient data to establish conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 282.56 crisis regime, CPI event in 2 days) creates severe near-term headwinds; utilities defensive positioning offers limited offset to systemic risk environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross + AO cross-up + 15x volume spike create strong short-term momentum setup with defined support at 50.1754 for tight stop placement.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis regime (VIX 282.56, inverted yield curve, CPI in 2 days), overbought technicals, price below all intermediate moving averages, zero fundamental support, and high earnings risk (105 days) create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
